name: Renewable Energy Lab
tagline: Model solar, wind, and geothermal adoption on a building and see savings, payback, and carbon avoided.
description: Simulates adopting solar PV, wind, and geothermal systems on a building for its location, projecting energy savings, payback period, NPV/IRR, and carbon avoided, and exports a campus energy report.

page.objective: Compare renewable-energy options for a building on financial terms, not just technical ones.
page.problem: Comparing solar, wind, and geothermal adoption for a building normally means separate technical and financial workups per system.
page.solution: One building location and system selection runs cost, performance, payback, and carbon-avoided figures together, and exports them as a campus energy report.

highlights.headline: Solar, wind, and geothermal adoption modelled through to payback and carbon avoided.
points: Runs cost-breakdown and performance simulations separately for solar PV, wind, and geothermal systems.
Projects payback period, NPV, and IRR against each system's capital cost.
Frames the roof itself as an energy plant ('Energy Sky') and rolls everything into a campus energy report.
